RITUALS OF WINTER

This season of the hermit is the dark time of the year, the archetypal hearth  where the soul  can find respite  and support.   During this portal,  lean on rituals to  embrace the  season's shadows  and wisdom.

Write by candlelight. Light a candle, allowing the flickering glow to fill your room. By the soft glow, write your intentions for the year ahead, dreaming of possibility and celebrating the magic of Winter.
Ritual One:

Commit to learning. Seek a new skill, embrace a hobby, reach for the unread book on your shelf, or take a snowy walk to the library. What you learn in the cocoon of Winter will support the seeds you plant in Spring.
Ritual Two:

Practice Green Magic. Cultivate a houseplant, blend a new tea and sip, or brew medicine like fire cider or herbal salves. The soil of Spring is cultivated in Winter. Connecting with plant magic can strengthen your roots in the earth even when all appears dormant.
